description: Get the latest instantaneous (~15-min, real-time) values for up to 100 USGS sites in one call — per-site, per-parameter records with timestamp, value, unit, and provisional/approved qualifiers. Omitting parameterCd returns every parameter each site publishes. A site measuring one parameter with several sensors returns one series per sensor, each named by methodId (its time-series ID) and methodDescription; a sensor that reported nothing in the period still returns, with totalValues 0. At most 100 series return per call — every site that returned a series keeps at least one, and totalSeries reports how many the upstream returned; pass parameterCd or split the sites across calls to reach the rest. Each series returns only its 10 most recent records (totalValues reports the true count); truncated=true when either cap applied. Use water_get_series for a full date-range series. Sites that return no series are listed in missingSites, not dropped silently. Find site numbers with water_find_sites; water_get_site_data_catalog lists the parameters and sensors a site measures and when each last reported.

parameterCd.description: Parameter codes to return. Omit to get every parameter each site publishes — one series per site, parameter, and method, so a large batch can exceed the 100-series cap. Use water_list_parameters to discover codes.

items.description: A 5-digit USGS parameter code (e.g. "00060" for discharge).

period.description: ISO 8601 duration for the lookback period (e.g. "PT2H" = last 2 hours, "P1D" = last 1 day, "P7D" = last 7 days). Default: "PT2H" (last 2 hours of readings). Widening it raises totalValues, but each series still returns only its 10 most recent records — use water_get_series to retrieve a full series. At most 1,100 days (e.g. "P3Y"); a longer period is refused upstream.

sites.description: One or more USGS site numbers to query. Maximum 100 per call.

items.description: A USGS site number (8–15 digits, e.g. "01646500").

name: water_get_readings

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `no_data_for_parameter`: No requested site returned a series — each site either does not exist or has no instantaneous series of the requested parameter(s). A site whose sensor reported nothing in the period returns a series with totalValues 0 instead. `invalid_request`: The USGS Water Data API rejected the request. Input formats are validated before the call, so this surfaces a value that is well-formed but unacceptable upstream. `upstream_error`: The USGS Water Data API returned a server error or a response it could not read, and retrying did not clear it. `upstream_timeout`: The upstream requests, retries included, ran past the 45-second budget for this call. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

missingSites.description: Requested site numbers that returned no series — the site does not exist, or has no instantaneous series of the requested parameter(s). A site whose sensor reported nothing in the period is not listed here: it returns a series with totalValues 0. Empty when every requested site returned a series. Check a listed site with water_get_site_data_catalog: not_found means no such site, an empty series list means it never measured the parameter, and each row’s endDate gives its last report.

items.description: A requested USGS site number that returned no time series.

query.description: Query parameters used for this request.

readings.description: Time series per site + parameter + method combination, ordered by site number, parameter code, then the sensor's first observation. At most 100: past that, series are kept round-robin across sites — every site's first series, then every site's second — with a site's series carrying values ahead of its empty ones, a series whose every record is no data counting as empty.

items.description: Time series result for one site + parameter + method combination.

methodDescription.description: Description of the sensor, built from the series metadata as "<sublocation>, [<web description>]" (e.g. "From multiparameter sonde, [Discontinued]"), or either part alone when the other is blank (e.g. "From multiparameter sonde", "[Radar]"). Null when the metadata leaves both blank, as it does for the default series at most single-sensor sites.

methodId.description: Time-series ID of this sensor series — the OGC time_series_id, the same value water_get_site_data_catalog lists as timeSeriesId. A site can measure one parameter with several sensors or at several locations — each is its own series and its own entry in readings. Null only when the upstream sent the series without an ID.

parameterName.description: Parameter description from the USGS parameter-code catalog, units included (e.g. "Discharge, cubic feet per second").

siteName.description: Human-readable USGS site name (e.g. "POTOMAC RIVER AT LITTLE FALLS, MD").

totalValues.description: Number of value records the upstream returned for this sensor over the requested period, before the 10-record cap. Equals values.length when nothing was capped. 0 when the sensor reported nothing in the period — the endDate water_get_site_data_catalog lists for its timeSeriesId gives its last report.

unitCode.description: Unit of measure for the values in this series (e.g. "ft3/s", "ft", "deg C").

values.description: Time-ordered value records for this site and parameter, capped at the most recent 10. Compare with totalValues to see whether the period held more; use water_get_series for the full series.

items.description: A single instantaneous reading for this site and parameter.

qualifiers.description: Data qualifier codes for this value: the approval code first, then one per qualifier.

items.description: A USGS data qualifier code (e.g. "P" = provisional, "A" = approved, "e" = estimated). A qualifier with no code is the upstream word as written (e.g. "OTHERAGENCY").

value.description: Measured value as a string. Empty string when the upstream reported no value for that interval — qualifiers then give the reason (e.g. "Ssn" seasonal, "Dis" discontinued, "Dry", "Eqp" equipment malfunction).

total.description: Number of site + parameter + method time series returned in readings (at most 100).

totalSeries.description: Number of site + parameter + method time series before the 100-series cap. Greater than total exactly when the cap dropped series; narrow with parameterCd or split the sites across calls to get the rest.

truncated.description: True when either cap applied. The series cap: totalSeries > total — pass parameterCd or split the sites across calls. The 10-record cap: some readings[].totalValues > values.length — use water_get_series for the full series.

title: Water Get Readings
